title: Shuffle words, prefix counts, inversions, signs and evaluation
statement: Let $a,b\in\mathbf N$ and $n=a+b$. Define $W_{a,b}$ to be the set of lists of length $n$ with letters $H,V$, exactly $a$ letters $H$ and $b$ letters $V$. For $w\in W_{a,b}$ and $0\leq k\leq n$, define $A_k(w)=\#\{r<k:w_r=H\}$ and $B_k(w)=\#\{r<k:w_r=V\}$. Define $I(w)=\#\{(r,s):0\leq r<s<n,\ w_r=V,\ w_s=H\}$ and $s(w)=(-1)^{I(w)}\in\mathbf Z$. For arbitrary sets $X,Y$ and sequences $x=(x_0,\ldots,x_a)$ and $y=(y_0,\ldots,y_b)$, define $z_{x,y}(w)=((x_{A_k(w)},y_{B_k(w)}))_{k=0}^{n}$, a list of length $n+1$. The letters are encoded by $H=\mathrm{false}$ and $V=\mathrm{true}$. Repeated sequence entries are allowed; the definitions include $a=0$, $b=0$ and the empty word.
